title: StopSlop configuration
description: Configuration for StopSlop. The knip property is the sole source of Knip configuration; project Knip configs are ignored.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for completion and validation.

anyOf.description: Report functions strictly above this cognitive complexity.

minMembers.description: Minimum members for the dispersion gate.

sizeMembers.description: Member threshold for the size gate.

sizeComplexity.description: Complexity threshold for the size gate.

maxPerFile.description: Maximum exported classes allowed in one file.

minTokens.description: Minimum token span reported as a clone.

minLines.description: Minimum physical lines reported as a clone.

exports.description: Report unused exports and exported types.

files.description: Report files unreachable from an entry point.

orphans.description: Report functions kept alive by nothing but their own paired test.

knip.description: Complete JSON-compatible Knip configuration. knip.json, knip.config.* and package.json#knip are ignored.

hubFanInRatio.description: Fan-in fraction above which a member is treated as shared glue.

$schema.title: JSON Schema
$schema.description: Pointer to the schema against which this document should be validated.

ignoreWorkspaces.title: Workspaces to exclude from the report

include.title: Include issue types in the report

exclude.title: Exclude issue types from the report

ignoreIssues.title: Ignore specific issue types for specific file patterns

dynamicImports.title: Include dynamic import() edges in cycle detection (excluded by default)

allow.title: Allow (accept) specific cycles by exact path, relative to the root and omitting the closing repeat of the first file

tags.title: Exclude (-) or include (+) exports with the specified JSDoc/TSDoc tags

preprocessor.title: Preprocess the results before providing them to the reporter(s)

preprocessorOptions.title: Extra options to pass to the preprocessor

treatConfigHintsAsErrors.title: Exit with non-zero code (1) if there are any configuration hints

treatTagHintsAsErrors.title: Exit with non-zero code (1) if there are any tag hints

ignoreBinaries.title: Binaries to exclude from the report (regex allowed)

ignoreGlobalBinaries.title: Ignore common global binaries
ignoreGlobalBinaries.description: Set to false to report required binaries otherwise excluded by Knip's default list. Explicit ignoreBinaries entries still apply.

ignoreDependencies.title: Dependencies to exclude from the report (regex allowed)

ignoreFiles.title: Unused files to exclude from the report

ignoreUnresolved.title: Unresolved imports to exclude from the report (regex allowed)

includeEntryExports.title: Include entry files when reporting unused exports

ignoreMembers.title: Enum and namespace members to exclude from the report (regex allowed)

globPatterns.description: Use file paths and glob patterns to match files. Knip uses tinyglobby and picomatch (https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch)

entry.title: The entry files target the starting point(s) to resolve the rest of the imported code.

project.title: The project files should contain all files to match against the files resolved from the entry files, including potentially unused files.

ignore.title: Files to exclude from the report (any issue type)

ignoreIssues.title: Ignore specific issue types for specific file patterns (relative to the workspace root)

config.title: The custom dependency resolver of this plugin is applied to the files listed here. Also see https://knip.dev/explanations/plugins

entry.title: The entry files target the starting point(s) to resolve its imported dependencies, like regular source code.

project.title: The project files should contain all files to match against the files resolved from the entry files for this plugin, including potentially unused files.
